needed.evidence: The left side of the road has no formal sidewalk; it is an unpaved, uneven strip of dirt and gravel that is partially obstructed by parked vehicles and debris.
needed.suggestion: Construct a paved, continuous footway on the left side of the road to provide a safe and accessible path for pedestrians.

needed.evidence: The right side of the road lacks a formal sidewalk, consisting of an informal, unpaved path that is partially blocked by parked cars and other obstructions.
needed.suggestion: Construct a paved, continuous footway on the right side of the road to provide a safe and accessible path for pedestrians.

needed.evidence: The informal path on the left side of the road is uneven and has significant trip hazards, including potholes and debris.
needed.suggestion: Resurface the left-side footway with a smooth, even surface to eliminate trip hazards and improve pedestrian safety.

needed.evidence: The informal path on the right side of the road is uneven and has significant trip hazards, including potholes and debris.

needed.suggestion: Install a marked pedestrian crossing at a suitable location to provide a safe place for pedestrians to cross the road.

needed.evidence: There are no street lights visible along the road in any of the frames, which is a concern for pedestrian safety, especially at night.
needed.suggestion: Install street lights along the road to improve visibility and safety for pedestrians and drivers, particularly at night.
